about: Skill moments (PLAN 8.2, 8.5): a 30-90 second lesson inside a song. Each has a plain name, the term that it unlocks (or null), STE instruction text, a demo (notes + hand positions) and a pass rule (tries correct tries). 'steps' are the keys of one try; without 'steps', each demo note start is one step. ladder.json puts each skill moment in a song.

skills.name: Stay where your hand sits
text: Put your right thumb on [[middle_c]].
Put one finger on each white key next to it: C, D, E, F, G.
In this song, your hand stays there. You do not move it.
Play the 5 keys, one finger after the other.

skills.name: Press the same key again
text: Sometimes the same key comes 2 or 3 times in a row.
Lift your finger a little after each note. Then press the same key again.
Play E 3 times with finger 3.

skills.name: Hold a long note
text: A long note falls as a long block of color.
Press the key when the note touches the line. Hold the key down until the end of the note goes past the line.
Play E, then D. Then hold D down for 1 second or more.

skills.name: Move your hand a little
text: Look for the arrow below the keys. The arrow shows where your hand goes next.
Play C 2 times with your thumb.
Then move your thumb to D. Now finger 4 is on G.
Play G 2 times and A 1 time.

skills.name: Play with the click
text: The click is the beat of the song. Each click is one beat.
Listen to the clicks in the demo.
Play one key on each beat: F, F, F, G. Then hold A for 2 beats.

skills.name: Wait in a pause
text: A rest is a pause: a time with no keys.
Lift your finger and count the rest like [[beat|a beat|one click]].
Play C, G, C. Lift your hand for [[beat|1 beat|1 click]]. Then play C again.

skills.name: Keep the same speed
text: Tempo is the speed of the song.
Play at the same tempo from the start to the end. Do not go faster on the easy notes.
Play G, A, G, F, E, F, G slowly and evenly.

skills.name: Finger numbers on the left hand
text: Your left thumb is also finger 1. Your left little finger is finger 5.
Put your left thumb on G. This G is 3 white keys to the left of [[middle_c]]. Put one finger on each white key to the left.
Play E, E, F, G with fingers 3, 3, 2, 1.

skills.name: The thin lines
text: Look at the thin lines across the falling notes. Each line starts a new bar.
In this song, a bar has [[beat|4 beats|4 clicks]]. The small number next to the line is the bar number.
Play the 4 notes of bar 2: G, F, E, D.

skills.name: The jump between 2 keys
text: An interval is the jump between 2 keys.
From C to G is a jump of 5 white keys: C, D, E, F, G.
Play C 2 times with finger 5. Then move your hand to the right. Play G 2 times with finger 2.

skills.name: Play with both hands
text: First, play each hand alone. Then play both hands together, slowly.
Press C with both hands at the same time.
Then play D and E with your right hand. Press G with your left hand together with E. Then play C with your right hand.

skills.name: The black key
text: This song uses a black key. It is the black key right of A.
Put your right thumb on F. Put your other fingers on G, A, the black key and C.
Finger 4 plays the black key. Press it in the middle, a little in from the front edge.
Play A, the black key, the black key again, then A. Use fingers 3, 4, 4, 3.

skills.name: The names of the black keys
text: A black key has two names. Each name comes from a white key next to it.
Sharp means the black key just right of a white key. Flat means the black key just left of a white key.
So the black key between A and B is B flat. Its other name is A sharp.
Put your right thumb on F. Play F, A, B flat and C with fingers 1, 3, 4 and 5.

skills.name: Move your hand to a new place
text: In this song, your hand moves to a new place 2 times. The arrow below the keys shows the new place.
Lift your hand a little before the move. Then put each finger on its new key.
Play F and E with fingers 3 and 2. Then move your thumb to F.
Play F, F, G, A, the [[sharp_flat|B flat|black key]], A, G, F with fingers 1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 1.

skills.name: Press 3 keys together
text: A chord is 3 or more keys that you play at the same time.
Put your left little finger on the C left of [[middle_c]]. Put finger 3 on E and your thumb on G.
Press C, E and G at the same time. Hold the 3 keys down together.
Each chord has its name from its lowest key. C, E and G together is the C chord.

skills.name: Happy and sad sounds
text: Some [[chord|chords|groups of keys]] sound happy and bright. They are major [[chord|chords|groups of keys]].
Other [[chord|chords|groups of keys]] sound sad or soft. They are minor [[chord|chords|groups of keys]].
C, E and G together is C major. A, C and E together is A minor.
Play C major, then A minor. Listen to the change. Your fingers 5, 3 and 1 keep the same shape.

skills.name: Change [[chord|chords|the keys]] on time
text: In this song, the [[chord|chord|3 keys]] in your left hand changes from C to G, and back.
Move your hand during the last click before the change. Then press the new keys on time.
For G, put your little finger on G. Then press G, B and D together with fingers 5, 3 and 1.

skills.name: A pattern that repeats
text: A progression is a list of [[chord|chords|groups of keys]] that repeats. This song uses 8 [[chord|chords|groups of keys]], then they come again.
Each [[chord|chord|group of keys]] lasts 2 [[beat|beats|clicks]]. Move your left hand to the next one on time.
Play the first 2: D, [[sharp_flat|F sharp|the black key right of F]] and A. Then A, [[sharp_flat|C sharp|the black key right of C]] and E.

skills.name: The same 4 [[chord|chords|groups of keys]] in many songs
text: Many pop songs use the same 4 [[chord|chords|groups of keys]]: C, G, [[major_minor|A minor|A with a sad sound]] and F.
Each one lasts 4 [[beat|beats|clicks]]. Then the [[progression|progression|pattern]] starts again.
Play C, then G, then A, then F with your left hand. Use fingers 5, 3 and 1 each time.

skills.name: The same pattern in a new place
text: You can play the same [[progression|progression|pattern]] from a different first key.
From G, the 4 [[chord|chords|groups of keys]] are G, D, [[major_minor|E minor|E with a sad sound]] and C.
D has a black key in the middle: [[sharp_flat|F sharp|the black key right of F]]. Your hand shape stays the same.

skills.name: A finger goes over the thumb
text: Sometimes the next key is just left of your thumb. Then finger 2 goes over the thumb.
Put your right thumb on G. Play A with finger 2 and G with your thumb.
Then cross finger 2 over your thumb to [[sharp_flat|F sharp|the black key just left of G]]. Then play G again with your thumb.

skills.name: The 8-key walk
text: A scale is a walk of 8 keys, one after the other. This scale goes from [[middle_c]] up to the next C.
Put your right thumb on [[middle_c]]. Play C, D, E with fingers 1, 2, 3.
Then your thumb goes under to F. Play F, G, A, B, C with fingers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

skills.name: The thumb goes under
text: To play more than 5 keys in a row, your thumb goes under your hand.
Put your right thumb on [[middle_c]]. Play C, D, E with fingers 1, 2, 3. Keep finger 3 on E.
Move your thumb under your fingers and play F. Then play G with finger 2.

skills.name: Broken [[chord|chords|groups of keys]]
text: A broken [[chord|chord|group of keys]] plays its keys one after the other, not together.
In this song, the left hand plays the lowest key, then the middle key, then the top key.
Put your left little finger on D. Play D, F, A with fingers 5, 3, 1. Play it 2 times.

skills.name: Dadra: a feel of 6
text: Dadra is a rhythm of 6 [[beat|beats|clicks]] from Indian music. Count 1 2 3 4 5 6. Counts 1 and 4 are strong.
Your left hand plays the lowest key on 1 and on 4. On 2 and on 5, it plays the 2 upper keys together.
Put your left little finger on A. Play A, then C and E together. Do it 2 times.

skills.name: Keherwa: a feel of 4
text: Keherwa is a rhythm of 4 [[beat|beats|clicks]] from Indian music. Many film songs use it.
Your left hand plays the lowest key on 1. Just after 2, it plays the 2 upper keys together.
Then it plays the lowest key on 3 and the 2 upper keys on 4.
Put your left little finger on C. Play C, then E and G together. Play C again, then E and G.
